parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description:
The IDs of one or more launch templates.

- You can query up to 100 launch templates at a time.

- You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName
parameters.description:
The names of one or more launch templates.

- You can query up to 100 launch templates at a time.

- You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the launch template list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: TemplateResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the launch template belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

> Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: TemplateTag
parameters.description:
The list of tag key-value pairs of the launch template itself.
> Currently, you can create and query tags of launch templates only by calling API operations. You cannot create or view tags in the console.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the launch template. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that have all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1000. If the resource count exceeds 1000, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation to query resources.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the launch template. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
